description: This file defines an abstract Room database class for a to-do list application, managing Task and Category entities, and providing singleton access through a companion object.

classes.name: TodoDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class representing the Room database, providing DAOs for tasks and categories, and implementing singleton pattern for database instance.

methods.name: taskDao
methods.description: Abstract method to access TaskDao for task database operations.

methods.name: categoryDao
methods.description: Abstract method to access CategoryDao for category database operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Companion object method to get the singleton instance of the database, creating it if it does not exist.
